acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

clearOhlcResult(bytes32).details: Clearing OHLC restores the ability to post a scalar resolve result for the same marketId.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getResult(bytes32).details: OHLC and scalar resolve are mutually exclusive: posting one forbids the other for the same `marketId`. When OHLC exists, `getResult` returns its close; otherwise the signed resolve value.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

clearLockSample(bytes32).notice: Owner can clear a lock sample before the engine consumes it (mis-post recovery).

clearOhlcResult(bytes32).notice: Owner can clear an OHLC result before the engine consumes it (mis-post recovery).

clearResolveResult(bytes32).notice: Owner can clear a resolve sample before the engine consumes it (mis-post recovery).

getLockSample(bytes32).notice: Lock-time sample for Direction markets (checkpoint A).

getResolveObservedAt(bytes32).notice: Wall-clock style observation time committed in the signed resolve payload.

hashLockClaim(bytes32,int256,uint64,byte.notice: EIP-712 digest the trusted reporter signs for `postLockSample`.

hashOhlcClaim(bytes32,int256,int256,int2.notice: EIP-712 digest the trusted reporter signs for `postOhlcResult`.

hashResolveClaim(bytes32,int256,uint64,b.notice: EIP-712 digest the trusted reporter signs for `postResolveResult`.
